final: SELECT ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS matched_record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY tr.ordertypedist) AS fraction_within_order_type FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink WHERE ab.peercorr >= 0.149 AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist ORDER BY fraction_within_order_type DESC LIMIT 10
